hints: find walks up parent[] until it reaches a vertex that is its own parent. That vertex is the set's representative.
Path compression is one line inside find: reassign parent[x] to the root you just found, so the next lookup is immediate.
unite must compare ROOTS, not the vertices themselves. Attaching parent[b] = a instead of parent[find(b)] = find(a) silently loses whole sets.
source: DSA theory: Kruskal's analysis and implementation using disjoint sets
title: Disjoint set union (find, unite)
